organization: Illinois Department of Public Health (via Cornell LII)
title: 77 Ill. Adm. Code 830.100 License Application for Commercial Structural Pest Control Business Location
claim: Anyone doing commercial structural pest control in Illinois needs an IDPH business license; applicant must employ at least one Illinois certified technician at the location, file a certificate of insurance and pay the Section 9(a) fee.
excerpt: employs at least one Illinois certified structural pest control technician at the business location to oversee pest control activities
limitations: LII copy of the administrative code (updated quarterly); fee amount is in Act Sec. 9(a), not this section; ilga.gov unreachable during research.

organization: Illinois Department of Public Health (via Cornell LII)
title: 77 Ill. Adm. Code 830.120 and 830.270 Certification exam application; Supervision of a Non-certified Technician
claim: Non-certified technicians may apply pesticides under a certified technician's supervision; physical presence is required until at least two supervised uses of each pesticide type at each site type; afterwards the supervisor must be reachable by voice and able to reach the site within one hour. Exam applications must arrive 15 days before the exam.
excerpt: At a minimum, on-the-job training requires at least two supervised uses of each type of pesticide applied at each type of work site
limitations: Rule text only; label requirements can be stricter. 830.120 read at https://www.law.cornell.edu/regulations/illinois/Ill-Admin-Code-tit-77-SS-830.120.

organization: Illinois Department of Public Health (via Cornell LII)
title: 77 Ill. Adm. Code 830.230 Certified Technician at Each Location
claim: Each licensed location must employ a certified technician who supervises non-certified staff and keeps pesticide records; no certified technician may be the only CT for more than one business location; a consultant cannot be the only CT.
excerpt: No Ilinois certified structural pest control technician shall be employed as the only certified structural pest control technician for more than one business location.
limitations: Implies each new branch needs its own CT (hire or promote).
